tools.name: ask_henry
tools.description: Ask HenryKnows a question about F-1/J-1 student immigration, SEVIS, OPT, CPT or related rules and get a cited answer. Ask in the person's own terms; do not add identifiers. Answers take 10–40 seconds. Read-only: nothing is stored.

tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Search HenryKnows' knowledge base (regulations, SEVP/USCIS guidance, Federal Register rules) and get the matching passages with their source links, so you can read and cite the text yourself. Fast; no model call. Read-only: nothing is stored.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect to the HenryKnows page the person is watching (its light turns green) and get the session for share_to_page. Only for people who gave you a session code or asked to follow along on a page. Side effects: creates a session, or links the one the person gave, and returns that session and the pag

tools.name: share_to_page
tools.description: Add a question and its HenryKnows answer (or a search and its passages) to the thread on the HenryKnows page the person connected, so they can see it there with its sources. Only for people who connected a page. Side effects: appends one entry to that page's thread, kept 24 hours; nothing else chang

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_to_page · Public sink: share_to_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_to_page · Public sink: share_to_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
